title: Compact Marching Cubes welded-edge cache key
description: Implement the next safe slice of TSK-0008: replace the four-field tuple dictionary key used by MarchingCubesExtractor's welded vertex cache with one dimension-aware Int64 edge identity. The canonical identity remains the lower grid corner plus edge axis; zero-axis point keys are encoded in a separate class so exact corner intersections cannot collide with incident edges. Use actual corner dimensions rather than arbitrary bit packing so rectangular grids remain collision-free. Keep the existing dictionary ownership model for now; a later benchmark must decide whether a direct indexed edge table is worth its memory cost. Also reuse a single 12-slot loop-index buffer per extraction rather than allocating an int array for every contour loop.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implemented on the audit branch. MarchingCubesExtractor now uses a single extraction-local 12-slot loop buffer and a dimension-aware long edge/corner cache key. A council self-review caught and corrected two intermediate key designs: arbitrary 12/4-bit packing and an incorrect cornersX-for-Y linearization. Rectangular-grid parity coverage was added to lock the final identity model. Benchmark and Unity parity validation remain required before declaring the optimization complete.
